
**spruce-RG351P-overlay.zip:** spruce's RG351P files, for spruce versions that do not include the RG351P yet. It is cut from spruce's Development branch and replaces some shared spruce files with whole copies, so pair it only with a spruce nightly matching the *Overlay base* below: with an older or a newer spruce, those shared files can break other spruce features. It is for a fresh install: right after step 5's spruce `.7z`, extract this zip into the same **SPRUCEOS** drive and choose *replace all*. Extracting it again over a spruce that is already set up re-runs the first start. On a Mac, Finder's *Replace* deletes whole folders: use Terminal, `ditto -x -k --norsrc spruce-RG351P-overlay.zip /Volumes/SPRUCEOS`, then `dot_clean -m /Volumes/SPRUCEOS`.

The overlay leaves your spruce settings alone; the RG351P's *Menu button* option is added to them on the first start.
